From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: AcmeCloud procurement & MAP — next steps (post-demo)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on procurement and get an implementation kickoff scheduled: 

Recap
- Demo: Redwood dedicated inference with predictable throughput, billing, and VPC options.
- Key success criteria: <10% latency increase vs target, SLO-backed uptime, and vendor onboarding for PCI/data controls.

Questions / procurement path
1) Preferred commercial path: do you want to proceed via corporate P.O. (preferred by many enterprise buyers) or do you want to purchase via credit card / marketplace listing?
2) Who is the procurement/finance contact we should coordinate vendor setup with?
3) High-level timeline for Legal -> Security -> Finance -> PO issuance (ballpark in business days) — this helps us propose a MAP.

Proposed MAP (draft milestones)
- 2026-03-16: Security intake complete / questionnaire reviewed
- 2026-03-18: Legal review (first pass)
- 2026-03-19: Vendor onboarding forms submitted to Finance
- 2026-03-26: Target PO issuance / contract signature

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW to make it easier for your procurement team to review. Can you confirm preferred commercial path and whether the target MAP dates are realistic? If helpful, we can schedule a 20-min procurement sync with Camila (she runs procurement ops for accounts).

Attachments: Redwood_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf (pdf), SOW_Redwood_AcmeCloud_draft.docx (docx)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACMECLOUD-2026-042

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement & MAP — next steps (post-demo)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few answers from our side: 

- Commercial path: Procurement prefers to proceed via corporate PO (not marketplace) for this engagement — they want Redwood on our vendor list.
- Procurement contact: Alex Kim (cc'd) will be the primary procurement/finance intake. Alex will own vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Timeline (approx):
  * Legal review: 3-5 business days (first pass)
  * Security intake: already started; I attached the filled questionnaire we returned to our security team for your records.
  * Finance/vendor onboarding: ~7-10 business days after we submit vendor info (vendor form + W-9)
  * PO issuance target: aiming for week of 3/22-3/26 assuming no major redlines

Implementation kickoff: we'd like to target the week after PO. Can you provide a final SOW and estimate for required kickoff resources?

Attachment: ACMESECURITY_questionnaire_filled.pdf

Jordan Ellis
Head of Platform Engineering | AcmeCloud
jordan.ellis@acmecloud.com
+1 (650) 555-0103
